title: Casts of doubles and decimals to integers: half to even and half away from zero
description: DuckDB rounds casts of `FLOAT` and `DOUBLE` to integers half to even (`CAST(1.5::DOUBLE AS INTEGER) = 2`, `CAST(0.5::DOUBLE AS INTEGER) = 0`, `CAST(126.5::DOUBLE AS TINYINT) = 126`; `float_integer_cast.test`), and casts of `DECIMAL` half away from zero (`CAST(0.55 AS INTEGER) = 1`, `CAST(-0.55 AS BIGINT) = -1`, `CAST(2.5 AS INTEGER) = 3`). `avg(d)::INTEGER` rounds too, half to even, since `avg` is a `DOUBLE`. (Corrected 2026-11-04: this said half away from zero for doubles as well; the earlier examples were `DECIMAL` literals.)
Shim: sverify's SQL writes `CAST(trunc(x) AS BIGINT)` (`DuckDBDialect.float_to_int`).
reference: Substrait: the cast's rounding is not specified.
Lean: truncates (`ftoi`), as DataFusion does. Decided on #209: the reference truncates toward zero, so no Lean change.

provenance.notes: Decided: the reference truncates toward zero.

evidence.note: FLOAT and DOUBLE to TINYINT … HUGEINT: 0.5 → 0, 1.5 → 2, -0.5 → 0, -1.5 → -2, 0.55 → 1, -0.55 → -1: ties to even
the range check applies to the rounded value: 127.5 → out of range for TINYINT (rounds to 128), 126.5 → 126, -128.5 → -128; TRY_CAST gives NULL where CAST raises
DECIMAL 0.55 → 1 and -0.55 → -1 for TINYINT … HUGEINT (no tie)

provenance.notes: Casts of FLOAT and DOUBLE round half to even; the description's half away from zero holds for DECIMAL only (its examples are DECIMAL literals and not ties). The lift's DuckDB profile has both (`sql_lift/_base.py`: float_to_int TIE_TO_EVEN, decimal_to_int TIE_AWAY_FROM_ZERO). The shim truncates first, so it is unaffected.

evidence.note: TryCastDecimalToNumeric: adds half of 10^scale with the input's sign, then divides: half away from zero

provenance.notes: No test casts a DECIMAL tie to an integer; the source reading covers it.
